name: Pi + ESP32 Dev
postCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y netcat-openbsd git-lfs && git lfs install
postStartCommand: sudo nohup tailscaled --tun=userspace-networking --socks5-server=localhost:1055 > /tmp/tailscaled.log 2>&1 & sleep 3 && sudo tailscale up --authkey=$TS_AUTHKEY --hostname=codespaces
